output: Manchester City captain Vincent Kompany has criticized UEFA's Financial Fair Play (FFP) regulations, claiming they protect elite clubs rather than promoting competition and preventing teams from going bust. According to Kompany, the regulations allow established clubs to maintain their success and prevent smaller teams from challenging them, citing the example of Manchester United's ability to spend £150 million despite being in debt. Kompany believes that the owners' investments in Manchester City, which have led to the team's success, would be impossible under a fully enforced FFP system.

Jeff Williams, a 26-year-old England Sevens international, has signed with Aviva Premiership side Bath for next season. Williams, who has scored 36 tries on the World Series circuit and helped England win the Tokyo Sevens, brings a high-tempo style of play and a physical edge to the team. According to Bath head coach Mike Ford and England Sevens head coach Simon Amor, Williams' signing fits the club's policy of recruiting young English talent and will suit the team's attacking ethos.

Director David Ayer revealed the first full look at Jared Leto as the Joker in the upcoming movie "Suicide Squad," where he will play the iconic comic book villain. Leto, who has fully embraced the role, has cut his hair and shaved his face for the part, marking the first time he will portray the character on the big screen since Heath Ledger's portrayal. The movie, which also stars Will Smith and Margot Robbie, is set to hit theaters on August 5, 2016.

The suspects were caught after an FBI informant met them and they were shown fake evidence of the inmate's murder, with each of them reacting positively to the news.

Despite this, Tevez is confident in his Juventus team's ability to succeed in the Champions League, citing their defensive solidity as a key factor.

A 45-year-old New Jersey woman, Dawn Milosky, was rescued from her overturned vehicle by police officers in Kinnelon, New Jersey, just as it started to catch fire. The baby goat, weighing 5kg at birth, is growing healthily and has become one of the most playful goats on the farm, with an extraordinary appetite. West Ham is planning to sign Real Madrid's Javier Hernandez, a 26-year-old striker on loan from Manchester United, as part of their summer recruitment programme. The child was rescued by his parents before emergency responders arrived, and was taken to the hospital with minor bumps, bruises, and a leg injury, but was listed in stable condition. The zoo plans to press child endangerment charges against the family, citing eyewitness accounts that suggest the child was intentionally dangled over the railing.

The law bans "propaganda of nontraditional sexual relations around minors" and bars public discussion of gay rights and relationships within earshot of children. This decision reflects the uncertainty and fear surrounding the law, which has faced international criticism and sparked protests since its passage in 2013.

Newcastle midfielder Siem de Jong made a comeback from a collapsed lung by playing 45 minutes for the Under 21s against Derby County, but the team lost 2-0. Despite his return, De Jong's next game, a visit to Spurs on Sunday, seems unlikely due to the subdued performance of the Under 21s against Derby.

Chef Ally Lees of Alfie Bird's restaurant in Birmingham created a massive three-foot omelette containing 12,000 calories and 945g of protein, which is 16 times the recommended daily amount for a man. Three Olympic gold medallists, Jessica Ennis-Hill, Mo Farah, and Greg Rutherford, will participate in the Sainsbury's Anniversary Games at the Olympic Stadium in London this summer.
